name: Subtitle Overlay
author: dhsdb010
description: Show .ass, .srt and .smi subtitles over any web video.

changes: Subtitles can be dragged in fullscreen
Keyboard shortcuts no longer fire while typing in text boxes
No more errors in open tabs after the extension updates
Uses no CPU on pages without a video
Built-in color picker for custom text color
Drag subtitles on the video to move them
First release: .ass subtitles over any HTML5 video
